Detailed Steps: 1. Log in with a user that has active membership. 2. On the left sidebar click "Inventory" (or the menu that contains inventory). 3. Then click "Products" (you may need to expand the Inventory menu first). 4. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The page should show the Products screen. 2. You should either see a list/table of products OR a message like "No products yet" with a button to add a product. 3. The page should not show a blank screen or spin forever (no infinite loading). 4. The URL at the top of the browser should contain something like "inventory" and "products".

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in and go to Inventory > Products. 2. If there are no products yet, note what you see. If there are products, use a different account or environment where the product list is empty.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The page should load without errors. 2. You should see a clear message or empty state (e.g. "No products" or "Get started by adding a product"). 3. There should be a visible button or link to "Add Product" or "Add New Product" so the user knows what to do next.

Detailed Steps: 1. Ensure there are more products than fit on one page (or use an account that has many products). 2. On the Products page look for "Next page" or page numbers at the bottom. 3. Click "Next" or "2" to go to the next page.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The list should update and show the next set of products. 2. The products on page 2 should be different from page 1 (no duplicates). 3. You should be able to go back to page 1 if a "Previous" or "1" link exists.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Products page find the search box or filter (often at the top). 2. Type a product name or select a filter (e.g. by category). 3. Press Enter or click Search/Apply.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The list should update to show only products that match your search or filter. 2. If no products match, you should see a message like "No results found". 3. Clearing the search or filter should show the full list again.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Inventory > Products. 2. Find and click the button that says "Add Product" or "Add New Product" (usually at the top right or in the empty state). 3. Wait a moment.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A pop-up window (modal) should appear on the screen. 2. The modal should contain a form with at least a field for "Product name" or "Name". 3. There should be a Submit/Save button and usually a Cancel or X button to close. 4. The rest of the page may be slightly darkened behind the modal.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Inventory > Products and click Add Product so the modal opens. 2. Do NOT fill in any required fields (leave Product name and any other required fields empty). 3. Click the Submit or Save button.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should NOT close. 2. You should see red or highlighted validation messages (e.g. "Product name is required" or "This field is required") under or next to the empty required fields. 3. No new product should be created. 4. You can then fill the fields and submit again to succeed.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Inventory > Products and click Add Product. 2. In the Product name field type a name (e.g. "QA Test Product 1"). 3. Fill any other required fields if the form shows them. 4. Optionally fill optional fields (description, category, etc.). 5. Click Submit or Save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The modal should close. 2. You should see a short success message (e.g. "Product created" or a green toast). 3. The product list should refresh and your new product should appear in the list (or on the current page). 4. The new product name should match what you entered.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open the Add Product modal. 2. Type something in the Product name field (or any field). 3. Click Cancel or the X button to close the modal (do NOT click Submit).
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The modal should close. 2. No new product should be created (check the list: the product you typed should not appear). 3. No success message should appear.

Detailed Steps: 1. Create a product with a specific name (e.g. "Duplicate Test"). 2. Open Add Product again and try to create another product with the exact same name. 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. If the system does not allow duplicate names: you should see an error (e.g. "A product with this name already exists"). No second product should be created. 2. If the system allows duplicates: both products should appear in the list. Note the actual behavior in Spotted Problems.

Test Case: Add Product - special characters in name
Detailed Steps: 1. Open Add Product. 2. In the product name field type a name with special characters (e.g. "Product "Test" & Co.''" or "Café product"). 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The product should be created successfully. 2. In the product list the name should display correctly with all the special characters and accents. 3. No error or broken display should occur.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open Add Product. 2. In the product name field paste or type a very long text (e.g. 200+ characters). 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Either: the system accepts it and the name is saved (possibly truncated in the list), OR you see a validation message (e.g. "Maximum length exceeded"). 2. The page should not crash or show a technical error. 3. Note the actual behavior in Spotted Problems.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Inventory > Products. 2. In the list find a product and click Edit (or the pencil icon) on that row. 3. A form or modal should open. Change the product name or other fields. 4. Click Save or Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear. 2. The product list should show the updated name/data. 3. If you open the product again (view or edit), the changes should be there.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open Edit Product for an existing product. 2. Clear the product name (or another required field) so it is empty. 3. Click Save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not save. 2. A validation message should appear (e.g. "Product name is required"). 3. The original product data should remain unchanged.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Inventory > Products. 2. Click on a product name or the "View" / view icon for a product.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A detail view or page should open showing that product's information (name, description, category, etc.). 2. The data shown should match what is in the list and what was entered when the product was created or last edited.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Inventory > Products. 2. Find a product and click Delete (or the trash icon). 3. When the confirmation message appears (e.g. "Are you sure you want to delete?") click Confirm or Yes.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The product should disappear from the list. 2. A success message should appear. 3. The product should no longer appear when you refresh or search.

Detailed Steps: 1. Click Delete on a product. 2. When the confirmation pop-up appears click Cancel or No.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The pop-up should close. 2. The product should still be in the list. 3. No deletion should occur.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in and go to Inventory in the sidebar. 2. Click "Categories" (next to or under Products). 3. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Categories page should open. 2. You should see a list of categories OR an empty state with an option to add a category. 3. The URL should contain "categories". 4. No blank screen or endless loading.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Inventory > Categories when there are no categories (or use an account with no categories).
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The page should load. 2. You should see a message or empty state (e.g. "No categories"). 3. There should be an "Add Category" or similar button if the app allows creating categories.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Categories page click "Add Category" or "Create Category". 2. Fill in the required field(s) (e.g. category name). 3. Click Submit or Save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear. 2. The new category should appear in the categories list. 3. The name should match what you entered.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open Add Category. 2. Leave the required field(s) empty. 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Validation message(s) should appear. 2. No category should be created until required fields are filled.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Categories page click Edit on a category (or open it and click Edit). 2. Change the category name or other fields. 3. Click Save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Success message should appear. 2. The category list should show the updated name.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Categories page click Delete on a category. 2. Confirm when asked.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The category should be removed from the list. 2. A success message should appear.

Detailed Steps: 1. When adding or editing a product, select a category from a dropdown or list (if the form has this field). 2. Save the product. 3. View the product list or product details.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The product should show the selected category in the list or detail view. 2. The category name should be correct.

Detailed Steps: 1. Ensure at least one product is assigned to a category. 2. Try to delete that category. 3. Confirm if asked.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Either: the system blocks deletion and shows a message (e.g. "Cannot delete: category is in use"), OR it deletes and products are updated per application rules. 2. Note the actual behavior in Spotted Problems.

Test Case: Product Items - open list for a product
Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Inventory > Products. 2. Click on a product to open its detail (or click the product name). 3. Find the "Product Items" or "Items" tab and click it. 4. Wait for the list to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. You should see the Product Items tab content. 2. Either a table/list of product items (with columns like Item name, Lot Number, Status, QR Code, Actions) OR an empty state with "No product items found" and an "Add Item" button. 3. No blank screen or endless loading.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open a product that has no product items yet. 2. Go to the Product Items tab.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. You should see a message like "No Product Items Found" with a short description. 2. An "Add Item" button should be visible so you can create the first product item.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open a product and go to the Product Items tab. 2. Click "Add Item" or "Add New Product Item". 3. Wait for the modal to open.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A modal titled "Add New Product Item" (or similar) should appear. 2. The form should have at least: Total Quantity, Unit (if applicable), and sections for identifiers/pricing (e.g. Variation name, SKU, Purchase price, Sales price). 3. There may be optional fields (weight, dimensions, dates, lot number). 4. Submit and Cancel buttons should be visible.

Test Case: Add Product Item - create one item
Detailed Steps: 1. Open Add Product Item modal for a product. 2. Enter Total Quantity = 1 (or leave default). 3. Fill required fields (e.g. variation name or SKU if required, purchase price, sales price). 4. Click "Add Item" or Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The modal may show a success state or close. 2. The product items list should refresh and the new item should appear in the list. 3. You may see a message like "QR Codes Generated" or option to "Create Another" or "Done". 4. The new item should show status and optionally a QR code.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open Add Product Item modal. 2. Enter Total Quantity greater than 1 (e.g. 5). 3. Fill required fields (variation name, SKU, prices, etc.). 4. Click Add Item or Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The system should create that many product items (e.g. 5) with the same specification. 2. A success message or summary should show how many were created (e.g. "5 items created"). 3. The product items list should show all new items. 4. If any failed, a partial success message may appear; note in Spotted Problems.

Test Case: Add Product Item - validation required fields
Detailed Steps: 1. Open Add Product Item modal. 2. Leave required fields empty (e.g. Total Quantity 0 or empty, or required price empty). 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not submit. 2. Validation messages should appear (e.g. "Total quantity must be at least 1", "Sales price is required"). 3. No product item should be created until the form is valid.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open Add Product Item modal. 2. Enter some data. 3. Click Cancel or the X to close.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The modal should close. 2. No new product item should be created. 3. The product items list should be unchanged.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Product Items list for a product, click "View Details" (or the view icon) on a product item row. 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A product item detail page or panel should open. 2. You should see item ID, variation name, quantity, status, prices, and optionally lot number, dates, dimensions. 3. There may be a "View QR Code" button.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the product item detail page click "View QR Code" (or similar). 2. A modal or section should show the QR code.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A QR code image or graphic should be displayed that corresponds to this product item. 2. This QR/barcode can be used for scanning in sales orders. 3. There may be a Print option. Note in Spotted Problems if QR is missing or wrong.

Test Case: Product Items - Add Items in Stock (bulk same spec)
Detailed Steps: 1. On the Product Items list find the "Add Items in Stock" or bulk-add action (if available) on a row or in the toolbar. 2. Click it. 3. Enter how many items to add with the same specification. 4. Confirm or Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The system should create the requested number of additional product items with the same spec as the selected/base item. 2. The list should refresh and show the new items. 3. If this feature does not exist, note N/A in Spotted Problems.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Product Items tab find the search box or filter (if available). 2. Type an item name, SKU, or lot number (or select a status filter). 3. Apply or press Enter.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The list should update to show only matching product items. 2. Clearing the search should restore the full list.

Test Case: Product Item - update or edit (if available)
Detailed Steps: 1. On the Product Items list or item detail find Edit or Update. 2. Change one or more fields (e.g. price, quantity). 3. Save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear. 2. The product item should show the updated data. 3. Note in Spotted Problems if edit is not available in your build.

Detailed Steps: 1. Find an action to change product item state (e.g. from Created to In Stock or Sold). 2. Perform the transition. 3. Confirm if asked.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The item status should update in the list and detail. 2. Behavior depends on business rules. Note actual options in Spotted Problems.
